scan.summary: This is a recreational marijuana producer license issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission authorizing Evergreen Botanicals, LLC to produce marijuana at its Eugene premises under a Tier II Indoor license with a 10,000 square foot canopy limit. The license is valid for one year and expires March 2, 2027, subject to conditions including annual renewal, employee permits, tracking system compliance, video surveillance, and reporting of ownership changes.
scan.freshness_note: This license is current and was issued March 3, 2026 for the term March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027. It will expire in approximately six months from today (September 28, 2026). A renewal application must be submitted no later than February 10, 2027 to avoid lapse.

conditions.title: License valid only for named premises
conditions.evidence_expected: The license itself, and confirmation that operations occur only at 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405.

conditions.title: Annual renewal requirement
conditions.evidence_expected: A completed renewal application and fee submitted to the Commission no later than 20 days before expiration (by February 10, 2027 for this license).

conditions.title: Cannabis Tracking System compliance and worker permits
conditions.evidence_expected: Records demonstrating all marijuana items tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and current marijuana worker permits for all employees who handle marijuana items.

conditions.title: Video surveillance maintenance
conditions.evidence_expected: Video surveillance system meeting OAR 845-025-1450 specifications, with recordings retained for at least 90 days.

conditions.title: Reporting of changes in ownership or financial interest
conditions.evidence_expected: Advance notice to the Commission before any change in ownership, premises, or persons with financial interest in the licensee takes effect.

deadlines.title: License renewal application and fee submission
deadlines.source_line: A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date.

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence on all facts read directly from the license. The license clearly states its own effective dates, conditions, and regulatory authority. The renewal deadline is unambiguous: a complete application must be received no later than 20 days before March 2, 2027, which is February 10, 2027. The license itself contains no gaps—it is the agency's issued document and is read as authoritative on its own terms. Conditions are clear and specific. The only area where confidence is lower is in interpreting what evidence Evergreen Botanicals should maintain to satisfy each condition, which requires inference about standard compliance documentation. The document does not specify dates when surveillance footage must begin being retained, what format worker permits take, or how Cannabis Tracking System compliance is verified in practice; these are operational details not stated in the license itself.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
